name: Collection of Sensitive Data from Host
description: This rule identifies potential attempts to collect sensitive data from a host system, such as password files, SSH keys, browser data, or other credential stores. Adversaries may gather this information to facilitate credential access, lateral movement, or persistence.
note:
- Review process.executable and process.args to determine what file or data was accessed.
- Check whether the file paths include sensitive content such as .ssh/id_rsa, /etc/passwd, or browser history locations.
- Investigate the source user and parent process to identify whether the activity was initiated by a script or shell session.
- Examine process trees to understand the broader execution context (e.g., was this part of a larger script or a standalone command?).
- Correlate with any recent login events or alerts about credential access, privilege escalation, or lateral movement.
- Search for archive creation (e.g., tar czf /tmp/…) or data staging in /tmp, /dev/shm, or other ephemeral locations.
false_positives: Legitimate administrative scripts may occasionally access similar paths — validate with system owners or change management records.
Backup, sync, or indexing services (e.g., rsync, scp) may copy sensitive files under expected conditions — cross-check the user and time of day.
Development or forensic tools might produce similar signatures; verify their use against allowed tools in the environment.
query:
event.dataset: "auditd.log"
AND event.action: "execve"
AND (
  (
    process.executable: "cat"
    AND (
      process.args: "/etc/passwd"
      OR process.args: "/etc/shadow"
      OR process.args: "*.bash_history"
      OR process.args: "~/.mozilla/firefox/*"
      OR process.args: "~/.ssh/id_rsa"
      OR process.args: "*ibdata1*"
    )
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: "ls"
    AND process.args: "~/.ssh*"
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: "find"
    AND (
      process.args: "*.docx"
      OR process.args: "*.pdf"
      OR process.args: "*.xlsx"
    )
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: "grep"
    AND (
      process.args: "*password*"
      OR process.args: "*confidential*"
      OR process.args: "*sshd*"
    )
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: "tar"
    AND process.args: "*czf*"
    AND process.args: "/tmp/"
    AND (
      process.args: "/etc/passwd"
      OR process.args: "/etc/shadow"
      OR process.args: "~/.ssh/id_rsa"
      OR process.args: "*.pem"
      OR process.args: "*.key"
      OR process.args: "*.conf"
      OR process.args: "*.db"
    )
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: ("cp" OR "scp" OR "rsync")
    AND process.args: "/tmp/"
    AND (
      process.args: "/etc/passwd"
      OR process.args: "/etc/shadow"
      OR process.args: "~/.ssh/id_rsa"
      OR process.args: "*.pem"
      OR process.args: "*.key"
      OR process.args: "*.conf"
      OR process.args: "*.db"
    )
    AND NOT process.args: "/var/tmp/mkinitramfs_*"
    AND NOT process.parent.executable: ("mkinitramfs" OR "update-initramfs" OR "apt" OR "dnf" OR "yum")
  )
  OR
  (
    process.executable: "dd"
    AND process.args: "if=/proc/kcore"
  )
)
